name: winwing-msfs2024-vibration
description: Unofficial Windows utility that maps MSFS 2024 SimConnect telemetry to WinWing Orion 2 vibration motors over HID

scripts.test: npm run test:cli && npm run test:launcher
scripts.test:cli: node test/vibration-core.test.js && node --test test/bridge.test.js test/bridge-host-protocol.test.js test/telemetry.test.js test/intensity-hid.test.js
scripts.dev:launcher: npm run build:bridge-host && npm --prefix apps/launcher run tauri:dev
scripts.build:cli: node scripts/assert-secure-node.js && npx --no-install @yao-pkg/pkg . --sea --target node22-win-x64 --output dist/WinwingVibration.exe && node scripts/verify-packaged-runtime.js dist/WinwingVibration.exe
scripts.build:launcher: npm run build:bridge-host && npm --prefix apps/launcher run tauri:build
